basis: The 311-member, 255-file archive passed path traversal checks, exact workspace byte equality, extracted-source tests, extracted build, and extracted version smoke.
Definitive normal and race suites each recorded 883 test passes and zero failures; go vet was clean.
SHA256SUMS validates all 13 bundle entries; release notes and immutable manifest use current hashes, test counts, -buildvcs=false provenance, and NOT PUBLISHED status.
This review contains no mutable acceptance-index, final-gate, or final-report hash, preserving one-way aggregate binding.
release_evidence_note: Human, legal, CI, and native-platform gaps remain release blockers but are not QA integrity defects.
